title: What a recruiter wants to see in resume bullets ✍️
description:
What do numbers do for your resume? Metrics are there to validate the claims you're making about your skills and SHOW that you have the experience necessary for the job you're applying for. Without that context resume bullets can just look like tasks. Tasks don't hold any value for a recruiter but an achievement that shows what you accomplishment and a numerical metric attached to that absolutely does. #resumetips #jobsearch #resume
